name: Yashiro Ichigaku
source:
A boy who spent his teenage days in the same facility as Takaya. He is one of the few people besides Lui that has known Takaya since childhood.
His strong point is tinkering with machines and gun customizing, although he is miraculously awful at everything else. As a User, his abilities are rather limited to only gun manipulation. He proclaims himself a sniper.
